overrides.rationale: Fortitude is printed at heading level 2 in the middle of the level-3 special-ability run (between Artificer and Supernatural ward). Level 2 would end the run and demote the remaining abilities to plain rules. The published SRD text lists Fortitude as a special ability alongside its neighbours, so extraction treats the heading as level 3. The source file is not modified.

The upstream conversion uses an empty Markdown link '[]()' to force a header row onto layout tables that have no printed column labels. The token is a rendering artifact, not content: typed columns normalize it to an empty label while rawText keeps the source lines verbatim.

anomalyReviews.observed: One level-2 heading inside the level-3 character special-ability run.
anomalyReviews.disposition: Handled by the fortitude-heading-level extraction override; the source line is unchanged.
anomalyReviews.rationale: Registered so any new or moved occurrence fails the anomaly gate until reviewed.

anomalyReviews.observed: Four editorial placeholders left by the upstream conversion ('@TODO add clock illustration', '@TODO style dropcaps.', '@TODO dropcaps', '@TODO add clock p99').
anomalyReviews.disposition: Retained verbatim in rule prose; they mark absent illustrations, not missing rules text.
anomalyReviews.rationale: Removing them would silently diverge from the retrieved source; they are inert in every projection.

anomalyReviews.observed: Adjacent bold spans separated by a space (for example 'costs** **1** **coin'), a conversion artifact of the site's inline styling.
anomalyReviews.disposition: Retained verbatim in prose fields. Name extraction reads only the leading bold span of a paragraph, so the artifact never reaches a typed name or slug.
anomalyReviews.rationale: The words themselves are faithful to the published text; only the emphasis markup is spliced.

anomalyReviews.observed: Eight '[]( )' empty-link tokens used as blank header cells in dot-rating and claim-map tables.
anomalyReviews.disposition: Normalized to empty column labels by the empty-link-column-placeholder override; rawText keeps the source lines verbatim.
anomalyReviews.rationale: The token carries no content; it exists to force a header row in GFM rendering.
